mcp_tool_inventory.root_cause: This Claude Code session is a continuation after context compaction of the session that predates the user-scope registration fix. When a session is continued via context compaction, it retains the MCP server list from the original session start. The user-scope entry in ~/.claude.json was added during that prior session (or immediately before it in Phase 15), but Claude Code only reads ~/.claude.json at session startup — not mid-session, not on conversation resume, not on context compaction. A full Claude Code application quit-and-relaunch is required for the new user-scope entry to take effect.

rhino_preflight.reason: No rhino tools callable in session

retries_and_errors.error: ToolSearch returns 0 rhino results; ListMcpResourcesTool server=rhino-cad returns 'not found'
retries_and_errors.resolution: None — blocked. Full Claude Code quit-and-relaunch required.
retries_and_errors.root_cause: Session continuation from context compaction predates user-scope registration. Claude Code does not hot-reload ~/.claude.json.

ambiguities.description: claude mcp get rhino-cad reports 'Scope: Project config (shared via .mcp.json)' even though a user-scope entry also exists in ~/.claude.json. This is because the CLI resolves the most specific matching scope for the current directory — since the CWD is inside the project root, it displays the project-scope entry. An operator cannot distinguish 'user-scope entry present' from 'project-scope entry only' by reading the CLI output alone.

This session is a context-compaction continuation of a prior session. It is ambiguous whether the original session was started before or after the user-scope entry was written. If the entry was present at original session start, this indicates a deeper issue where user-scope entries are not loaded even at startup from /Users/nes. If the entry was written mid-session (during Phase 15), the fix is simply to quit-and-relaunch. The fix to resolve the ambiguity: start a fully fresh Claude Code session from /Users/nes AFTER the user-scope entry was confirmed present.

friction_points.title: User-scope ~/.claude.json entry does not inject tools into continued/compacted sessions
friction_points.description: Claude Code reads ~/.claude.json at session startup only. Context compaction restores the prior session's MCP server list without re-reading the config file. A user-scope entry added after the original session start is not visible until a full quit-and-relaunch. This is the third consecutive POC run blocked at MCP tool visibility despite each prior fix being correctly applied.
friction_points.evidence: ~/.claude.json mcpServers.rhino-cad confirmed present. ListMcpResourcesTool: not found. ToolSearch: 0 results. Session type: context-compaction continuation.
friction_points.impact: Complete block of all Rhino operations. The fix (user-scope registration) was applied correctly but silently failed to activate because the session predates the fix.

friction_points.title: claude mcp get scope display misleads when user-scope and project-scope entries coexist
friction_points.description: When the CWD is inside the project root, claude mcp get displays 'Scope: Project config (.mcp.json)' even if a user-scope entry also exists. An operator who checks 'which scope is active' cannot determine from the CLI output alone whether the user-scope entry is present. The user-scope entry is invisible in the CLI display unless the operator is outside the project directory.
friction_points.evidence: CLI shows 'Scope: Project config'. Direct JSON parse of ~/.claude.json confirms user-scope entry also present. Operator cannot distinguish the two states from CLI alone.
friction_points.impact: Operator confusion; may cause incorrect diagnosis (e.g., concluding user-scope fix did not apply when it did).

friction_points.title: No documented requirement: full Claude Code quit-and-relaunch after MCP config changes
friction_points.description: Neither the operator guide, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, orient.sh, nor exchange.sh output mentions that Claude Code must be fully quit-and-relaunched after adding MCP server entries. Context compaction (which continues an existing session) does not trigger a config re-read. An operator who applies the user-scope fix, then resumes the same session via compaction, will hit the same invisible blocker.
friction_points.evidence: Phase 15 fix correctly applied. Phase 16 session is a compaction continuation. Tools absent.
friction_points.impact: Repeated blocking across POC runs despite correct config. Fourth consecutive phase blocked at MCP visibility.

friction_points.title: No session-scope MCP preflight in exchange.sh prepare
friction_points.description: exchange.sh prepare completes successfully and reports REQUEST_OK regardless of whether rhino-cad tools are visible in the current session. An operator who runs prepare and sees REQUEST_OK has no indication that the Rhino tools are absent until they attempt to call them.
friction_points.evidence: exchange.sh prepare → REQUEST_OK. Immediately after: ToolSearch rhino → 0 results.
friction_points.impact: Wasted branch setup effort; confusing gap between prepare success and tool call failure.

improvements_vs_phase15: User-scope ~/.claude.json entry is now confirmed present — Phase 15 fix applied correctly
No regression on orientation skill, git sync, server import, or CLI Connected status
Root cause of new sub-blocker identified: session continuation vs. full restart semantics

QUICK_WINS.title: Quit Claude Code completely and relaunch from /Users/nes for Phase 17
QUICK_WINS.description: The user-scope entry in ~/.claude.json is correct. The only remaining action is a full application quit-and-relaunch. After relaunch, rhino-cad tools should appear in the session's active server list. Verify with ListMcpResourcesTool server=rhino-cad immediately after relaunch before proceeding with any bridge work.
QUICK_WINS.impact: Should unblock all Rhino operations in the next POC run

QUICK_WINS.title: Document full quit-and-relaunch requirement in operator guide and AGENTS.md
QUICK_WINS.description: Add one paragraph to operator.md and AGENTS.md: 'After adding or modifying MCP server entries in ~/.claude.json, Claude Code must be fully quit and relaunched. Context compaction and new conversation windows within the same session do not trigger a config re-read. Verify tool availability with ListMcpResourcesTool immediately after relaunch.'
QUICK_WINS.impact: Prevents every future operator from hitting this silently

PROTOCOL_CHANGES.title: Add rhino-cad session-scope MCP preflight to exchange.sh prepare for Rhino tasks
PROTOCOL_CHANGES.description: After branch setup, exchange.sh prepare should verify rhino-cad is in the active session's server list (e.g., by checking ListMcpResourcesTool output or an equivalent session-scope probe). If absent, emit a clear error: 'rhino-cad not in session. Full Claude Code quit-and-relaunch required after user-scope registration. Do not proceed.' This fail-fast check prevents the operator from investing in branch setup only to block at the first rhino_status call.
PROTOCOL_CHANGES.impact: Catches the restart requirement at prepare time, not mid-run

PROTOCOL_CHANGES.title: Add a session-scope MCP inventory verification step to orient.sh operator output
PROTOCOL_CHANGES.description: orient.sh operator output should include a preflight section that reports whether rhino-cad is visible in the current session. A one-line summary — 'rhino-cad: IN SESSION (32 tools)' or 'rhino-cad: NOT IN SESSION — relaunch required' — would give the operator immediate situational awareness before any bridge work begins.
PROTOCOL_CHANGES.impact: Makes the session-scope gap visible before any branch work is started

PROTOCOL_CHANGES.title: Clarify claude mcp get scope display semantics when user-scope and project-scope coexist
PROTOCOL_CHANGES.description: Document that when CWD is inside the project root, claude mcp get shows the project-scope entry even if a user-scope entry also exists. Operators who want to confirm user-scope registration should parse ~/.claude.json directly or run claude mcp list from outside the project root.
PROTOCOL_CHANGES.impact: Prevents scope ambiguity confusion during debugging

MCP_RUNTIME_CHANGES.title: Investigate whether Claude Code supports runtime MCP server hot-reload
MCP_RUNTIME_CHANGES.description: If Claude Code 2.x supports a mechanism to hot-reload ~/.claude.json without a full restart (e.g., a CLI command or signal), document it and add it to the operator guide. This would allow operators to apply MCP config changes within an existing session without interrupting their workflow.
MCP_RUNTIME_CHANGES.impact: If hot-reload exists, eliminates the restart requirement entirely
